_doc: Job routes in route format v1 (schemas/route.schema.json). The demo route exercises every stage kind except script; T0.10 runs it with stand-in agents (stand_in_agents: true). The factory routes intake (gate G0-charter), design (parent G0-charter, gate G1-blueprint) and build (parent G1-blueprint, gate G2-golive) were added in T1.5 as skeletons: their agents are built in T2.4 (intake), T3.4 (design) and T4.1-T4.3 (build), which also set their final stages and reviewers. Until every agent file and reviewer rulebook exists, state.py new refuses a job on them. Intake (T2.4): the interviewer asks in rounds (AWAITING_INPUT) until it reports its status; the readiness script then scores it (engine/readiness.py) and below the threshold hands the job back to the interviewer (fix_with); then the charter-writer, the charter-critic, the charter-verifier and gate G0-charter. A stage's rules are the files its agent works from.
